歌曲搜索、歌单搜索和歌单歌曲查询返回协议 DTO。

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.search",
  "requestId": "search",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "keyword": "keyword",
    "pageIndex": 1,
    "pageSize": 10
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "music.search",
  "requestId": "search",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "album": "",
        "artist": "",
        "durationMs": 1000,
        "id": "searched",
        "name": "keyword",
        "pictureUrl": "",
        "source": "qq",
        "webUrl": "https://y.qq.com/n/ryqq/songDetail/searched"
      }
    ],
    "totalSize": 1
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "playlist.search",
  "requestId": "playlists",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "keyword": "keyword",
    "pageIndex": 1,
    "pageSize": 10
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "playlist.search",
  "requestId": "playlists",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "creator": "",
        "creatorId": "creator",
        "description": "description",
        "id": "list",
        "name": "keyword",
        "pictureUrl": "",
        "playCount": 0,
        "songCount": 0,
        "source": "qq"
      }
    ],
    "totalSize": 1
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.search",
  "requestId": "playlist-songs",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "keyword": "*list",
    "pageIndex": 1,
    "pageSize": 10
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "music.search",
  "requestId": "playlist-songs",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "album": "",
        "artist": "",
        "durationMs": 0,
        "id": "list-song",
        "name": "",
        "pictureUrl": "",
        "source": "qq",
        "webUrl": "https://y.qq.com/n/ryqq/songDetail/list-song"
      }
    ],
    "totalSize": 1
  }
}
